threads.body: The PR adds a 2.30.0 release entry and bumps snapshots to 2.31.0, but the API diff baseline remains 2.29.0. This can cause API-compat checks/docs to compare against an older release than intended; consider updating `apidiffBaselineVersion` to `2.30.0` (and regenerating associated apidiff artifacts) so the baseline matches the latest released version.
